answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 6275 Country: NZ Title: Can we eat meat killed by a christain? Question: Can we eat meat killed by a christain? Answer ID: 6275 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 565/565=M/1429) By ?killed by Christians? if you mean that they, instead of slaughtering animals in lawful way, kill them by strangulating or electric shock etc, then this is undoubtedly unlawful and haram , as it is maitah (carrion). And, if by killing you mean to slaughter or hunt, then also it should be avoided to eat meat slaughtered by Christians as today?s Christians or Jews are not following their religions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
